items.one_line_summary: BTC 从两年低点反弹 9% 重回 6 万美元，18 亿美元杠杆多头被强平出局
items.technical_summary: BTC 在触及两年低点后单日反弹约 9%，重新站上 60,000 美元。本轮下跌触发约 18 亿美元杠杆仓位清算，其中多数为押注上涨的多头头寸，意味着下跌由多头拥挤平仓放大，而非空头主动进攻。清算完成后价格快速收复整数关口，市场焦点转向周一美股开盘，用来判断这是空头回补的技术性反弹，还是风险偏好真正修复。原文正文实际只有一句话，且与标题重复，具体清算分布、交易所构成与时间戳均未给出。
key_points: 18 亿美元杠杆仓位被清算，主体是多头，BTC 自两年低点反弹 9% 重回 60,000 美元上方。
多头清算峰值常对应短期底部，可用资金费率由正转负、未平仓合约骤降 20% 以上作为反转确认条件。
原文只有标题和一句重复正文，缺清算币种分布、交易所明细和精确时间，需用 Coinglass、各交易所强平数据交叉核对。

items.limitations: 原文信息密度极低，正文仅一句与标题重复的话，无法据此判断清算数据来源与统计口径；60,000 美元与「两年低点」的相对位置需用交易所 K 线核实；单一媒体报道，未区分永续与交割合约、也未知是否含跨交易所重复计算；反弹 9% 属事后描述，不构成样本外可验证结论。

items.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
items.raw_text: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.
items.abstract: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.
items.one_line_summary: Block 旗下 AI 代码扫描器 Loupe 在 Bitcoin Core 中挖出 DoS 漏洞：重复同一 ID 5 万次可拖停节点，修复已于周五上线
items.technical_summary: Bitcoin Core 存在一条可被构造消息触发的拒绝服务路径：把同一个 ID 重复发送 5 万次，即可让节点陷入停滞。漏洞由 Block 旗下 Spiral 团队的开源扫描器 Loupe 定位，该工具用 AI agent 遍历 bitcoin 代码库做自动化审计，而非依赖人工逐行审阅。Bitcoin Core 已于周五发布修复版本。整条链路的意义在于：AI agent 首次在比特币核心客户端这类高 stakes 代码上产出可落地的安全发现，把「AI 做代码审计」从演示推进到实际修补。
key_points: AI 扫描器 Loupe 定位到 Bitcoin Core 的 DoS 路径：同一 ID 重复 5 万次即可使节点停滞，官方修复于周五发布。
节点停滞会同时打断交易所充提、行情推送和链上数据抓取，量化团队需在运维层加入区块高度落后、RPC 超时率和 mempool 异常的自动告警与熔断。
原文未给出漏洞编号、受影响版本范围、触发报文格式，也未说明是否已有在野利用；AI 扫描器的误报率与代码覆盖率同样未量化，发现本身仍需人工复核。
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模（节点/基础设施可用性） + 研究工具 / 工作流提效（AI agent 代码审计）
items.possible_use_case: 把「节点停滞」写进实盘监控与熔断规则：当自建 Bitcoin 节点的区块高度落后全网超过 2 个块、或 RPC 超时率 5 分钟内超过 10% 时，自动暂停依赖该节点的下单与充提套利策略，并切换到备用节点或公共 RPC。
items.limitations: 原文只有两句话的正文，缺漏洞编号（CVE）、影响版本区间、PoC 与在野利用情况；未说明修复是否向后兼容以及全节点升级采用率，未升级节点仍暴露在风险中。Loupe 作为 AI agent 扫描器的漏报与误报没有量化数据，不能把「AI 发现」等同于审计完备。URL 时间戳标为 2026-11-21，与当前时间不符，需核对是否为占位或转载。这是新闻稿而非技术公告，缺乏可复现的验证材料。

items.raw_text: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, which Onchain Lens said points to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.
items.abstract: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, which Onchain Lens said points to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.
items.one_line_summary: Chainflip 金库被提走 486 万美元且提款签名有效，FLIP 单日暴跌 30%，验证者密钥疑被攻破
items.technical_summary: Chainflip 的金库被提走约 486 万美元资产，链上分析账号 Onchain Lens 指出该笔提款携带合法签名，因此问题更可能出在「验证者用于批准金库付款的密钥被攻破」，而非合约逻辑漏洞。消息出来后 FLIP 代币单日下跌约 30%，属于典型的协议级信任崩塌式重定价。对量化侧的关键含义是：风险源从「智能合约代码」转移到「签名权限与多签/验证者集合」，这类风险无法通过代码审计覆盖，只能通过链上监控与仓位上限管理。
key_points: 金库被提走约 486 万美元，提款签名有效，FLIP 单日跌约 30%
可监控「金库大额提款 + 签名有效性」两类链上事件，作为 FLIP 及同类跨链代币的减仓触发
原文仅一句话反复重复，缺失发生时间、所在链、资金是否已冻结，追回概率无法评估
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模（跨链协议私钥/验证者密钥敞口）+ 因子/alpha 信号（安全事件驱动的代币做空与减仓触发）
items.possible_use_case: 在链上监控管线里加一条规则：当跨链协议金库出现单笔超过 TVL 一定比例（如 1%）的提款且签名验证通过、而团队未在 N 分钟内公开确认时，自动对 FLIP 及同赛道代币（THORChain、Wormhole 类跨链资产）触发减仓或开空；同时把该事件计入「协议安全事件」因子，用于回归代币暴跌后的反弹持续性。
items.limitations: 这是新闻快讯而非完整报道，正文只有标题加一句重复的导语，没有链上交易哈希、被盗资产构成、时间戳、是否有暂停提款或资金冻结，也没有官方回应，因此无法判断是单一验证者密钥泄露还是多数签名方被控；30% 跌幅未区分是消息冲击还是市场整体下跌；事件驱动做空在此类新闻上常遇到「消息已滞后、价格已跳空」的滑点问题，实盘需考虑流动性与借币成本。

items.title: US lawmakers propose up to 30% rewards for prediction market whistleblowers
items.raw_text: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.
items.abstract: Whistleblowers could receive 10% to 30% of monetary sanctions in qualifying prediction market fraud cases exceeding $1 million in penalties.
items.one_line_summary: 美国议员提议预测市场欺诈举报人可获罚金 10%–30%（门槛 100 万美元），抬高 Polymarket/Kalshi 类平台的操纵成本
items.technical_summary: 预测市场（事件合约）长期存在操纵和内幕交易取证困难的问题：单笔可疑交易获利可能只有几万美元，监管调查成本却远高于此。该提案仿照 SEC 举报人计划，用金钱激励内部人举报：在罚款金额超过 100 万美元的合格欺诈案件中，举报人可获得罚金的 10%–30%。若该提案进入立法，预测市场操纵的预期成本将显著上升，Kalshi、Polymarket 这类平台的做市商面对的逆向选择风险和信息不对称程度可能下降。原文只给出奖励区间（10%–30%）和罚金门槛（100 万美元）两个数字，未披露法案编号、发起人、适用平台范围与时间表。
key_points: 议员提议预测市场欺诈举报人可获罚金 10%–30%，仅适用于罚金超 100 万美元的案件，即单案罚金至少 100 万美元、举报人至少 10 万美元

items.title: Kalshi faces Monday hearing on New York order it says would shut down its exchange nationwide
items.raw_text: Kalshi, which is headquartered in New York, has said the order would shut it down nationwide, though NY's AG said that's not her goal.
items.abstract: Kalshi, which is headquartered in New York, has said the order would shut it down nationwide, though NY's AG said that's not her goal.
items.one_line_summary: 纽约州禁令听证会周一开庭，Kalshi 称将全国关停交易所，加密事件合约交易场所面临消失风险

items.title: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
items.raw_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges and graders to replace human annotators, raising the question of when such replacement is statistically justified. To support such decisions, the Alternative Annotator Test (Alt-Test) was introduced for dense settings where all items are annotated by the same annotators. However, in many large-scale annotation settings, items are annotated by different subsets of annotators. We therefore propose the Alternative Annotator Test with Resampled Annotations (AltRA-Test), a statistical test that does not require that all items are annotated by the same annotators. AltRA-Test uses a bootstrap that resamples items, draws k human annotations for each item, and substitutes one of them with an LLM annotation. This produces paired all-human and mixed human-LLM panels. A replacement is supported when the inter-annotator agreement (IAA) of the mixed panel is statistically non-inferior to the IAA of the all-human panel, i.e., when the LLM preserves the signal that the human annotators share. We establish that AltRA-Test is a consistent test of asymptotic level alpha. We then evaluate it through simulations and real-world experiments in which we test 18 LLMs and 5 prompting techniques on 20 datasets across text, image, audio, and video. Across these evaluations, about 100 items often suffice for the test. In simulations, where we know whether the LLM is a better or a worse annotator than the humans, AltRA-Test makes more correct replacement decisions than existing baselines. In real-world data experiments, LLMs pass the test in about half of the setups, depending mainly on the task. Since replacement is not always justified, we encourage researchers to test it for their task.

items.one_line_summary: AltRA-Test 用 bootstrap 重采样检验 LLM 能否替代人类标注，20 个数据集上约半数设置通过、约 100 条样本即可判定
items.technical_summary: 大规模标注中不同样本常由不同子集标注者完成，原有 Alt-Test 要求同一批标注者覆盖全部样本，无法直接使用。AltRA-Test 对样本做 bootstrap，每个样本抽 k 个人类标注，随机替换其中一个为 LLM 标注，构造配对的全人类面板与人机混合面板；若混合面板的 IAA 在统计上非劣于全人类面板，则认为 LLM 可替代人工。理论证明其为渐近水平 α 的一致检验。实验覆盖 18 个 LLM、5 种提示技术、20 个文本/图像/音频/视频数据集，约 100 个样本常足够；模拟中比现有基线做出更多正确替换决策，真实数据中约一半设置通过，且主要取决于任务。
key_points: 用 bootstrap 抽 k 个人类标注并替换 1 个为 LLM 构造配对面板；18 个 LLM、20 数据集约半数通过，约 100 条样本常足够。
可直接用于金融文本标注验收：需每个样本有多个人类标注和 LLM 标注，按任务跑 IAA 非劣检验；统计流程清晰，复现成本中等。
结论依赖 IAA 作为“共同信号”代理，未覆盖金融标签的收益/成本；真实任务约半数不通过，直接替换人工可能引入系统性偏差。

items.possible_use_case: 在构建新闻情绪、财报事件、公告分类等 A 股/美股文本因子时，先抽 100–300 条样本做 AltRA-Test：每个样本保留 k 个人类标注，替换 1 个为 LLM 标注，若 IAA 非劣再批量用 LLM 扩标；不通过则保留人工抽检。
items.limitations: 论文非金融场景；IAA 只衡量标注者间共同信号，不等价于下游因子 IC/夏普；真实数据约半数设置不通过，任务依赖强；需多人类标注，若只有单标注者无法构造 k 人面板；bootstrap 检验对样本量和标注质量敏感。

items.title: Optimal Control in Pairs Trading with Negative-Power Utility
items.raw_text: We solve a finite-horizon consumption and investment problem in a pairs trading model with an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck spread and utility $U(x)=-x^{-γ}$, $γ>0$. Linearizing the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation gives explicit formulas for the value function and the optimal feedback control. A budget inequality and concavity verify optimality over all admissible strategies with nonnegative wealth on every finite horizon, without Novikov's condition. Under the optimal feedback, wealth and consumption admit deterministic upper bounds when the interest rate $r$ is at most the mean-reversion rate $κ$. If $r>κ$, each exceeds any prescribed level with positive probability at every time after the start. When the critical time falls before maturity, expected wealth at that time is finite exactly when the initial spread is zero. We also show that the suprema of the negative powers of optimal wealth and consumption are integrable on every finite horizon exactly for orders $0<m\le 1+γ$.

items.title: Perfumer: A Large Language Model-based Agentic Framework Accelerating Structural Relaxation and Electronic Band Prediction for First-Principle Calculation
items.raw_text: First-principles structural relaxation and band calculations require substantial computation and expertise. Here we present Perfumer, a large language model-based agentic framework that couples Quantum ESPRESSO with two predictive models. Across tested structures, pre-relaxation with Perfumer-relax model followed by QE refinement yielded a 2.75-fold overall speedup over QE alone. Perfumer-band model combines a periodic graph neural network with a latent Hermitian spectral head returns 12 band energies at any requested wavevector, preserving reciprocal lattice periodicity and time-reversal symmetry without constructing Hamiltonian. Trained on 125,153 self-curated band structures, Perfumer-band model reaches a median per-material mean absolute error of 0.157 eV on 2,607 test materials, including lanthanide, actinide and magnetic compounds, from held-out composition families spanning 85 elements, taking about 97 ms per material on two consumer CPU cores. The agent turns natural-language requests into relaxation-to-band workflows, from a single uploaded structure to automatically constructed new candidates and returns predicted properties.

items.title: Path-Independent Deleveraging Rules
items.raw_text: We characterise path-independent auto-deleveraging (ADL) rules as an extended log-exponential family. Immunity to account splitting, merging and reopening further restrict the class. Homogeneity (essentially) restricts the class to a one-parameter family ordered by both fairness and platform risk. Its split-proof members continuously interpolate between proportional division and water-filling. Among these rules, decreasing the parameter reduces risk at the cost of increasing inequality in how accounts are treated. This suggests selecting the parameter through an ex-ante calibration to a risk bound on historical data to choose a maximally fair rule subject to that bound. A counterfactual replay of Hyperliquid's ADL episode on 10 October 2025 finds that a range of intermediate parameters significantly improves on the observed allocation in both burden dispersion and subsequent risk statistics.

items.technical_summary: 问题：交易所自动减仓时，按什么规则把破产账户的仓位分摊给对手方账户，才能既路径无关（不因账户拆分、合并、重开而改变结果）又把平台风险控制在界限内。方法：把 ADL 规则刻画为扩展 log-exponential 族，叠加抗拆分、抗合并、抗重开的条件，再用齐次性把可行类压缩为一参数族，该族在等比例分摊与 water-filling 之间连续插值。结论：参数变小降低平台风险，但账户间被分摊的不平等变大，构成单调权衡；因此建议对历史数据做 ex-ante 校准，在风险上界约束下取最公平的参数。实证：对 Hyperliquid 于 2025-10-10 发生的 ADL 事件做反事实回放，一组中间参数在负担分散度（burden dispersion）与后续风险统计上同时优于实际观测到的分配；摘要未给出具体改进幅度数值，需查正文。
key_points: 路径无关 ADL 在抗拆分/合并/重开与齐次约束下收敛为单参数 log-exponential 族，参数越小平台风险越低、账户间不平等越大
只需 ADL 触发时各账户仓位与保证金分配记录（链上公开可得），规则为闭式公式，可高保真复现并接入永续风控与回测
实证仅覆盖 Hyperliquid 单次 2025-10-10 事件，摘要未给任何夏普/回撤数值，风险上界可事后挑选，跨交易所外推未验证
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模、执行与交易成本。加密永续的强平与 ADL 是实盘尾部风险的直接来源，该框架给出可校准的分配规则族与风险上界参数化方式。
items.possible_use_case: 在加密永续组合构建阶段加入 ADL 风险约束：用链上历史 ADL 事件校准该单参数，估算给定持仓结构下被分摊仓位的名义比例与不平等程度，把最坏情形 ADL 损失折算成每个标的的持仓上限，写进现有风控回测的尾部情景模块。

items.title: Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
items.raw_text: Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics. However, how to construct proxies and prompts for optimal downstream quality remains underexplored, as do the capabilities and limitations of this paradigm. Through controlled experiments and blinded human evaluation, we study proxy granularity, physics simulation, and prompting. The results reveal task-dependent trade-offs: coarse proxies favor natural motion, while medium-grained proxies favor consistency. Physics simulation and proxy-aligned prompting further improve average quality. Guided by these findings, we introduce Coda-DaVinci, a task-adaptive agentic framework for Code2Video generation that selects between proxy-guided and direct generation, adapts modeling granularity to each entity, and coordinates simulation with proxy-grounded prompting. Its multi-agent harness preserves scene assets and guides repairs through visual inspection and independent review. Experiments demonstrate leading instruction following on VTR and scene consistency on R2M, improved physical plausibility over direct generation, and higher visual realism than the compared Code2Video baselines. Long-video evaluations further show gains in event structure and consistency across successive interactions, while revealing limitations in transition stability and adherence to scene settings.

items.title: Exposure-Aware Informative Path Planning Using Deep Reinforcement Learning
items.raw_text: This paper addresses the finite-budget exposure-aware informative path planning (IPP) problem for a fleet of mobile sensing agents. The agents map an unknown scalar field while limiting exposure to high field intensity. Existing IPP methods optimize informativeness under motion or resource constraints, but do not address field exposure constraints. We formulate exposure-aware IPP (EA-IPP) as a scalarized bi-objective belief-state Markov decision process that trades the normalized Gaussian-process (GP) information gain against a normalized measurement-derived fleet exposure index. A parameter-shared proximal policy optimization (PPO) framework with decentralized actors and a centralized fleet critic is trained offline and evaluated on unseen fields. Across the radar, plume, and wildfire field families, the EA-IPP agent achieves the lowest GP reconstruction RMSE among the evaluated baselines while retaining D-optimal information within $10\%$ of the non-learning information baseline. The minimum field exposure is approximately $34.6\%$, $20.1\%$, and $27\%$ below the non-exposure-aware baseline for radar, plume, and wildfire, respectively.

items.technical_summary: 美国参议院通过了一项名为 DEATH BETS Act 的法案，直接禁止预测市场平台上线与战争、暗杀、死亡挂钩的合约。立法动机是担心有人利用军事行动的未公开信息在事件合约上内幕交易。对交易端的直接后果是：Polymarket、Kalshi 这类平台上围绕地缘冲突、政要健康、军事行动的一整类合约将被迫下架或禁止新开仓，原本用这些合约概率作为信号的事件驱动策略失去数据源。原文未披露法案编号、投票票数、生效日期、罚则条款，也没有给出受影响合约的规模或未平仓量数据。
key_points: 美参议院通过 DEATH BETS Act，禁止预测市场上挂钩战争、暗杀、死亡的合约，核心理由是军事事件内幕交易风险。

items.title: Auto-Alpha: A Framework for Autonomous Factor Research
items.raw_text: Autonomous factor research requires generating economic hypotheses as well as implementing and testing them. We present Auto-Alpha, a framework that connects report-guided initialization to self-directed research through a test-driven implementation loop. An idea agent proposes economic mechanisms and signal constructions; a research agent develops them with backtest feedback. Semantic audit, quantitative review, and human admission select factors for a persistent library, while an Experience Library retains research insights. Starting from 120 research reports, Auto-Alpha builds an initial library of 32 factors. It then generates new ideas and refines existing candidates, producing 420 implementations and retaining 62 additional factors. We evaluate factor quality and portfolio performance using a fixed library snapshot of 105 factors. The median 1-day Rank IC is 0.0301, and a weekly Top-300 portfolio returns 16.81% annualized after stated costs over 2020-2026, versus 1.71% for the CSI 1000 price index. These retrospective results document an operating research process and its artifacts; controlled evaluation is needed to isolate the contribution of its components.

items.title: ForeSeek: Foresight-Driven Reasoning for Long-Form Video Understanding
items.raw_text: Long-form video understanding, as a fundamental yet crucial vision task, is being revolutionized by multimodal large language model (MLLM)-based video agents. However, the retrieval-driven nature inherent to these agents creates a significant bottleneck, forcing them to reactively fetch clips based on local saliency without a global temporal plan. To address this, we present ForeSeek, a foresight-driven video agent that transforms long-video reasoning from reactive retrieval into predictive exploration. Rather than blindly probing the timeline, ForeSeek forms visually grounded expectations over unseen temporal regions, verifies them through targeted observations, and continuously refines its search based on emerging evidence, where failed expectations serve as informative signals for principled backtracking. Furthermore, we develop a two-stage training framework that equips MLLMs with foresight-guided reasoning and efficient decision making. Extensive experiments on five long-video benchmarks demonstrate that ForeSeek consistently improves the efficiency--accuracy trade-off of long-video reasoning, achieving competitive or superior accuracy while observing $2.5$--$4.4\times$ fewer frames than the strongest search-based agent. Code is available at https://github.com/harry0021/ForeSeek

items.one_line_summary: 把视频 agent 从「见什么抓什么」改成「先预测、再定点验证、落空即回溯」，在五个长视频基准上精度持平或更高，采样帧数比最强搜索 agent 少 2.5–4.4 倍
items.technical_summary: 长视频理解的现有 agent 是检索驱动的：按局部显著性一帧帧盲目取片段，没有全局时间规划，导致帧预算被大量浪费。ForeSeek 反过来先对「还没看过的时间区间」生成有视觉依据的预期（比如某段应该出现什么事件），再用定点采样去验证；预期落空不是错误，而是被当作回溯信号，推动 agent 重新规划搜索路径。配套的是一个两阶段训练框架，第一阶段教会模型前瞻式推理，第二阶段优化决策效率（何时停、往哪跳）。在五个长视频基准上，精度与最强搜索式 agent 持平或更高，同时观测帧数只有后者的 1/2.5 到 1/4.4，代码已放在 github.com/harry0021/ForeSeek。
key_points: 预期落空被当作回溯信号而非失败，五基准精度持平或更高，帧数仅为最强搜索 agent 的 1/2.5–1/4.4
代码开源（harry0021/ForeSeek），但需 MLLM 两阶段微调加视频抽帧管线，复现算力与工程成本中等偏高
全部实验都在视频 QA 基准上，没有任何金融数据或成本/收益口径验证，跨域迁移完全未测
items.quant_relevance: 研究工具 / 工作流提效：给「预算受限的信息检索 agent」提供了一套可复用的预测—验证—回溯控制循环；数据工程：长视频/监控/路演录像这类另类数据的低成本抽样方案
items.possible_use_case: 把这套预测—验证—回溯循环搬到 10-K / 招股书 / 电话会转写的长文档 agent 上：先让模型对「产能扩张可能写在哪一节」生成预期，再定点读取该段落，命中就继续、落空就回跳到上一层目录重规划，目标是单份文档的 token 消耗压到现有 RAG agent 的 1/3，同时记录答案准确率是否下降；先拿 200 份年报做离线对照实验再决定是否上线。
items.limitations: 实验对象是长视频问答基准，评价指标是 QA 准确率，没有任何金融数据集、交易成本或因子有效性口径；把「帧预算」映射成「token 预算或数据采购预算」是类比而非原文验证，金融文本的信号稀疏度远高于视频事件，预期落空的频率会大幅上升，回溯可能退化成穷举；两阶段训练需微调 MLLM，复现门槛不低；基准本身存在训练集泄漏与标注噪声的常见风险，2.5–4.4 倍效率优势需要在自有数据上重测才可信。

items.title: Quantum Calibration of Local-Volatility Surfaces from Sparse Option Quotes
items.raw_text: Calibrating a volatility surface from sparse option prices requires repeated solutions of a pricing equation as the volatility parameters change. We implement a hybrid quantum and classical method for this inverse problem using the Dupire local-volatility model. A positive coefficient representation specifies the local variance, and linear combinations of Hamiltonian simulations approximate the associated pricing evolution. The circuit propagates through successive maturity intervals and evaluates discrepancies at the observed strikes. Measurement counts provide the objective values used by a classical optimiser to update the volatility coefficients. We implement this calibration cycle in a logical gate simulator and assess it alongside classical pricing solvers and alternative surface models. Multiple-maturity synthetic examples illustrate the reconstruction of smiles and skews, while a separate small circuit experiment tests the complete measured calibration. The comparisons quantify the effects of model flexibility, pricing approximation and measurement precision. Recorded gate counts and sampling budgets identify the main computational costs of the implementation.

items.one_line_summary: 用哈密顿量模拟的线性组合分段传播 Dupire 局部方差，在逻辑门模拟器上校准稀疏期权报价的波动率曲面，摘要未给出精度或加速比
items.technical_summary: 要解决的问题是：稀疏期权报价下每更新一次波动率参数，就要重解一遍定价方程，校准成本随参数维度快速上升。做法是把 Dupire 局部波动率模型中的局部方差写成正系数表示（平方形式保证非负），并用若干哈密顿量模拟的线性组合（LCU 型分解）来近似对应的定价演化算符；线路按期限区间逐段向前传播，在每个观测执行价上计算模型价与市场价的偏差，把测量计数转成目标函数值，交给经典优化器更新波动率系数，形成「量子估值 + 经典优化」的闭环。实验分两块：多期限合成算例用于重建微笑与偏斜形态，另有一个小规模线路做完整含测量的校准测试，全部在逻辑门模拟器上完成，并与经典定价求解器、替代曲面模型（参数化曲面）做对照；成本用记录的量子门数与采样预算衡量。摘要只说明对比量化了「模型灵活性、定价近似误差、测量精度」三者的影响，没有披露任何夏普、定价误差、加速倍数或门数的具体数值。
key_points: 分段哈密顿量模拟传播局部方差演化，测量计数驱动经典优化器更新系数；原文缺乏量化指标，结论待复核
仅逻辑门模拟器加合成多期限报价，无真实期权链；复现需量子线路模拟栈与 Dupire 正演求解器
理想模拟器无硬件噪声，未计入买卖价差与离散股息，也未证明对经典有限差分的实际加速
items.quant_relevance: 研究工具 / 工作流提效（定价方程反复求解的加速探索）；风险建模（稀疏报价下的波动率曲面校准）
items.possible_use_case: 短期不可落地交易。可操作的跟进方式是：把同一套稀疏执行价报价数据（例如某指数期权 5 个期限 × 7 个执行价）喂给现有 CPU 端 Dupire 校准器（QuantLib LocalVolSurface 的有限差分正演），记录经典侧的目标函数评估次数与耗时，再与文中报告的门数/采样预算换算对比，先判定这条路线在 3–5 年内是否有成本交叉点。
items.limitations: 全文在逻辑门模拟器上运行，等于零噪声、全连通、无退相干与读取误差的理想硬件假设，实际量子设备上的测量精度会显著劣化目标函数；数据全部为合成的多期限算例，没有真实期权链的买卖价差、离散股息、美式提前行权与流动性缺失问题；未给出任何定价误差（如 IV 均方根误差）或 wall-clock 加速数字，无法判断相对经典有限差分/蒙特卡洛的竞争力；稀疏报价下局部波动率本身是不适定反问题，需要正则化，文中未说明如何处理解的稳定性与过拟合；摘要信息密度低，具体图表与数值须查 arXiv HTML 版（https://arxiv.org/html/2611.25344）核实，本摘要基于定性描述。

items.title: A joint framework for SPX, VIX and VXX
items.raw_text: Options on VXX bring the dynamics of the VIX futures curve into the joint SPX-VIX calibration problem. We construct a common model by specifying the VIX and then recovering instantaneous SPX variance from the requirement that its risk-neutral conditional expected average over the next thirty days equals the squared VIX. With truncated signatures of time-extended polynomial diffusions, this recovery reduces to finite-dimensional linear algebra and gives explicit access to the futures underlying VXX. The same specification therefore governs equity variance and rolling volatility exposure. To accommodate flexible specifications while respecting variance nonnegativity, we develop a regularized model and quantify the pricing errors of its tractable VIX and VXX proxies. Applications to short-dated option smiles illustrate joint calibration across the three markets, with Monte Carlo estimates of the proxy error bounds well below quoted bid-ask spreads.

items.one_line_summary: 把 VXX 期权纳入 SPX-VIX 联合校准，用截断签名将瞬时方差恢复化为有限维线性代数，短期限微笑代理误差低于买卖价差
items.technical_summary: 解决 SPX、VIX 与 VXX 三市场期权无法统一校准的问题：先指定 VIX 过程，再利用 SPX 瞬时方差在风险中性下未来 30 天条件期望均值等于 VIX 平方的约束反解瞬时方差。方法使用时间扩展多项式扩散的截断签名，使反解退化为有限维线性代数，并显式得到 VXX 所依赖的 VIX 期货。为兼顾灵活性与方差非负，构造正则化模型，并量化可处理 VIX/VXX 代理的定价误差。短期限期权微笑展示三市场联合校准，Monte Carlo 估计的代理误差界低于市场报价买卖价差。
key_points: 指定 VIX 后按 30 天风险中性均值约束反解 SPX 瞬时方差，截断签名把恢复化为有限维线性代数并显式得到 VIX 期货。
需 SPX/VIX/VXX 期权及 VIX 期货数据；正则化保证方差非负，Monte Carlo 代理误差界低于买卖价差，校准可复现。
局限：仅展示短期限微笑，未给跨期限/压力期样本外结果；代理误差虽低于价差，但未计模型风险、参数不稳定与实盘对冲成本。
items.quant_relevance: 风险建模：为 SPX/VIX/VXX 联动定价与波动率对冲提供统一校准框架；研究工具：签名方法把高维校准降为有限维线性代数。
items.possible_use_case: 在现有 SPX-VIX 校准流程中加入 VXX 期权与 VIX 期货曲线约束，用于短期限 VXX 期权做市报价和 delta/vega 对冲。
items.limitations: 原文仅报告短期限期权微笑与 Monte Carlo 代理误差界；未给出跨多年样本外校准、参数稳定性、买卖价差之外的对冲/交易成本，正则化与截断阶数选择可能过拟合；VXX 产品规则和期货展期需单独建模。

items.title: Falsifiable Compositional Reasoning in Time Series Forecasting
items.raw_text: Time series foundation models as well as the language-guided analytical agents achieve strong accuracy on standard chronological benchmarks. However, models that rank highest on historical validation splits often degrade across non-stationary regime transitions. We hypothesise that this gap arises from using historical backtesting as an open-ended search and model-selection objective instead of using it to test pre-specified compositional assumptions. Real-world time series are generated by recurring latent primitives that co-move within finite historical windows. Under strong historical co-movement, chronological holdout error cannot separate predictors that learn invariant couplings among primitives from predictors that fit transient historical correlations. Searching over large pools of architectures, hyperparameters, or chain-of-thought rules further biases selection toward historical shortcuts. Through theoretical analysis and diagnostic experiments on a controlled multi-primitive benchmark and German day-ahead electricity prices, we show that expanding validation search fails to improve out-of-regime accuracy, and that decomposing primitives without an ex-ante falsification test still breaks down when residual correlations shift. Hence, we propose formulating time series forecasting and reasoning around falsifiable compositional hypotheses that combine neural primitive encoders, explicit coupling constraints, and training-calibrated falsification tests.

items.technical_summary: 历史回测被当成开放式搜索和模型选择目标，导致高验证集排名的预测器在非平稳 regime 切换后失效。用受控多基元基准和德国日前电价做诊断：扩大验证搜索不能提升跨 regime 精度；只分解潜在基元、不做事前证伪，残差相关性一漂移就崩。主张围绕可证伪的组合假设建模：神经基元编码器 + 显式耦合约束 + 训练期校准的证伪检验。原文未给出夏普、精度或收益数字。

items.title: Stock bubbles in limited participation models with power utilities
items.raw_text: We prove that the equilibrium state-price deflated cum-dividend stock-price process in Guasoni, Larsen, and Leoni (2025) is a strict local martingale. Our result is based on proving that the unrestricted trader faces an endogenously complete model.

items.raw_text: Quintenz said the possibility of insider trading doesn't make a market illegal and that enforcement should back up exchanges' efforts to prevent it.
items.abstract: Quintenz said the possibility of insider trading doesn't make a market illegal and that enforcement should back up exchanges' efforts to prevent it.
items.one_line_summary: Kalshi 高管 Quintenz 称预测市场内幕交易「更容易被看见」，暗示事件合约的异常建仓比股票更容易被监控抓出
items.technical_summary: 争议点是预测市场是否因内幕交易风险而应被限制或禁止。Kalshi 方面的核心论点是：内幕交易在预测市场上「只是更容易被看见」，因为事件合约直接对应二元结果，知情者下注痕迹比股票市场更集中、更易识别。因此内幕交易的可能性本身不构成市场非法的理由，监管执法应当补足交易所自身的监控努力，而不是关停市场。原文未给出任何成交量、异常账户占比、执法案例数量或时间表，属于纯立场表态，不含可验证的量化结论。
key_points: 原文缺乏量化指标，无成交量、异常账户比例、处罚案例数量等任何数字，结论待复核；唯一可提取的事实是 Kalshi 方主张内幕交易在预测市场「更容易被看见」
对交易者的直接含义：事件合约的内幕痕迹更集中，可把 Kalshi、Polymarket 的订单簿大额异动、临事件前的赔率跳变做成信息泄漏代理因子，或反过来作为事件合约做市的逆向选择风险敞口监控

items.abstract: Former CFTC Commissioner and Democrat Kristin Johnson and ex-SEC aide Steven Levine appeared before lawmakers Thursday.
items.one_line_summary: SEC 委员提名人 Johnson 表态支持代币化股票走正式规则制定，代币化美股合规路径有望打通
items.technical_summary: 两名 SEC 委员提名人 Kristin Johnson 与 Steven Levine 于周四出席国会听证，Johnson 明确支持通过正式规则制定程序（formal rulemaking）而非逐案豁免来规范代币化股票交易。这直接决定链上股票代币能否在美国合规流通，也决定做市商、托管与结算环节的合法性边界。对量化侧的含义是：若规则落地，代币化美股将获得与现货并行的连续交易时段（含美股休市时段），价差与流动性结构会重构，产生新的跨市场套利和日内波动信号。原文信息极薄，仅两句话且正文重复标题，无投票结果、无规则文本、无生效时间。
key_points: 两名 SEC 委员提名人周四在国会听证，Johnson 表态支持以正式 rulemaking 而非个案豁免规范代币化股票交易。
若规则落地，股票代币将获准在美股休市时段连续交易，可做代币价格对现货的领先滞后与价差回归信号。

items.title: AgroGround: What Grounding Fine-Tuning Changes in Agricultural Vision-Language Models
items.raw_text: Large-scale agricultural grounding data can now be generated automatically, but how training on such data affects a vision-language model's localization, recognition, and refusal capabilities remains unclear. To study these effects, we introduce AgroGround, containing 794,850 automatically grounded agricultural instructions for training and a separate benchmark of 1,478 human-verified images for evaluation. Among these images, 500 are independently re-annotated, yielding an inter-annotator instance F1 of 0.789. We use controlled comparisons to isolate the effects of different training choices on localization, recognition, their joint correctness, and refusal. Grounding-only fine-tuning reduces four-way recognition from 51.7% to 29.2%, with predictions showing a strong candidate-position bias. However, changing only the instruction format raises recognition to 72.7% while maintaining similar grounding performance. Training with healthy-image negatives achieves 94.1% refusal on healthy images, but only 28.6% refusal of incorrect target names on positive images, showing that these two refusal behaviors do not necessarily improve together. Reinforcement learning reveals a further trade-off, improving localization by 0.014 F1 over a matched supervised control while reducing recognition and refusal. Across model families and held-out training sources, localization transfers more reliably than recognition and target-specific refusal. External benchmarks further show that the gains depend on the domain and task. Together, these findings show that grounding fine-tuning changes the balance between localization, recognition, and refusal rather than improving all three uniformly.

items.technical_summary: Large-scale agricultural grounding data can now be generated automatically, but how training on such data affects a vision-language model's localization, recognition, and refusal capabilities remains unclear. To study these effects, we introduce AgroGround, containing 794,850 automatically grounded agricultural instructions for training and a separate benchmark of 1,478 human-verified images for evaluation. Among these images, 500 are independently re-annotated, yielding an inter-annotator instance F1 of 0.789. We use controlled comparisons to isolate the effects of different training choices on localization, recognition, their joint correctness, and refusal.
